programs=base/'programs'; programs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row}
    marker = next(v for v in colors if v not in (0, 6))
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == marker]
    r0, c0 = min(r for r, c in cells), min(c for r, c in cells)
    shape = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in cells]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h - max(dr for dr, dc in shape)):
        for c in range(w - max(dc for dr, dc in shape)):
            if all(grid[r+dr][c+dc] == 0 for dr, dc in shape):
                for dr, dc in shape:
                    out[r+dr][c+dc] = marker
    return out
'''
